set.notes: Gujarat has no state entrance test for BBA/BCom/BA. GCAS (gcas.gujgov.edu.in) covers 15 state universities (Gujarat Univ, MSU Baroda, Sardar Patel Univ, Saurashtra, VNSGU etc.) and ~26 private universities (incl. Silver Oak, LJ, CHARUSAT). Big private universities (Nirma, GLS, Ahmedabad Univ) run their own merit process. Exceptions with own tests: PDEU (separate entry), Karnavati KUAT, Navrachana BBA-NUVET (separate entries). Nirma's All-India BBA-MBA seats need IPMAT. Not in scope / no UG route: IIM Ahmedabad, MICA (PG only), CEPT (design/architecture). Adani University and Indus University: no BBA admission route confirmed.

next_cycle.expected: GCAS UG registration usually opens in May after Class XII results (2026: 7–28 May); merit rounds through June. Private universities (Nirma, GLS) open from Jan–Feb.
